method: For every Stage2 item_sids.json on disk, recompute the frozen gate's validation metrics with tools/genrec-mcp/stage2_quality_gate.py against the pinned pairs (results/stage3_T5Train/monotonicity/behavior_pairs_valid_s42.npz, 52855 pairs, 1 positive + 10 negatives, seed 42) and join by Stage2 arm name to the Stage3 test_final.json test_recall@10 of the same arm.

reference_arm_that_equals_the_er_cutoff.note: The frozen ER cutoff is exactly this arm's measured value, which is why the gate demands strictly greater.

claim: Within the same data, capacity and frozen Stage3 protocol, the SID's independent-validation discriminability and prefix diversity order the downstream Stage3 R@10 almost perfectly: every arm above L2 14800 and ER 14.7 scored 0.0624-0.0643, every arm below L2 6400 and ER 6.1 scored 0.0545-0.0560.
claim_boundary: Spearman on 12 arms is a directional diagnostic, not a causal model; arm names are joined heuristically and several arms differ in auxiliary objectives. Compare only within this table.
next_candidate_target: Beat the reference arm on the same pinned validation pairs: Hard-L1 ER > 16.3895, L2 prefixes above the 16145 reference band, HitRate at least the reference 0.07944.
blockers_for_stage3_admission: MIN_VALID_L1_HITRATE is None in tools/genrec-mcp/stage2_quality_gate.py, so stage3_start refuses every SID regardless of quality.
The ER cutoff equals the resample arm exactly and is strict-greater, so the frozen baseline TIGER_RQ-VAE (ER 6.468) and the rejected c117 SID (ER 6.089) are both refused.
